verdict.rationale: No evidence pack items mention a point-of-sale (POS) product, in-person/retail hardware checkout, or a unified POS-online catalog/inventory/customer sync; there is only a mention of 'wholesale and retail operations from a single catalog' which does not indicate an actual POS system. This is a fair question for an ecommerce platform (many competitors ship POS), so the axis applies but is unaddressed.
